segments.name: Bioelectronic Innovations
segments.description: Develops and commercializes non-invasive bioelectronic devices for prescription migraine and headache treatment and general wellness and human performance markets.
segments.evidence: The Company views its operations and manages its business as one operating segment: Bioelectronic Innovations.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from sales of its prescription and general wellness devices to customers, including through ecommerce marketplaces, distributors and government-related arrangements.
revenueModel.evidence: We are subject to risks associated with the commercialization of our product offering through ecommerce marketplaces.
